business_state_rewrite_reason: The active project legitimately changed strategy after a real Fanqie signing-quality rejection and the user's explicit authorization removed the previous high migration-cost constraint. The user then exposed a second-order craft-mastery gap: orchestration/rebase controls were stronger than the explicit system model for what novel skills must be mastered, where to learn them, how deeply, and how to prove that mastery. Historical prose/publication facts remain preserved while the owner adds a mastery model, series master outline and project benchmark before candidate rewriting.
external_publication_fact_preserved: CH1-CH7 confirmed published historically; CH8 publication remains unconfirmed; internal rebase does not infer withdrawal/replacement.

artifact_io.reason: Novel Writing persists canonical project/checkpoint state, Canon/prose/review artifacts, publication/signing facts, historical baselines, master-outline/rebase architecture and replacement candidates whose identity, freshness, invalidation and retention are governed explicitly.

operational_hygiene.reason: The owner has release hard gates, reminder-dependency repair, signing-feedback recovery, mastery-gap recovery, outline/rebase supersession rules, stale-dependent-hash handling, deterministic release-evidence validation and periodic regression before release/promotion.

evolution.reason: The owner applies the Universal candidate-adoption and M0-M11 evolution method to material user/platform failure signals, and now explicitly adds competency ontology, learning-source hierarchy, L0-L4 evidence boundaries, project benchmarks and series architecture so the user does not need to enumerate missing novel disciplines.

hook_bindings.observability_or_incident_evidence_locat: hash-bound project reviews/acceptance/execution-evidence/checkpoints plus platform-signing/rebase/mastery learning audits and CHANGELOG.md
hook_bindings.self_maintenance_trigger_path: SKILL.md platform signing-feedback + full-rebase + mastery sections: a user/platform hard signal or reminder-dependency incident triggers failure classification, capability-gap check, evidence scout, candidate comparison, benchmark, supersession and regression without requiring the user to enumerate internal craft disciplines
hook_bindings.garbage_collection_owner_and_dependency_: continuity/ARTIFACT_CONTEXT_GOVERNANCE.json#superseded_artifact_cleanup_rule with historical FINAL/Canon retention and dependency checks
hook_bindings.reliability_or_change_freeze_guard: SKILL.md release/rebase/mastery gates plus runtime/recovery_guard.py and runtime/release_evidence_guard.py: no old ARC_001 resume, CH9 continuation, replacement promotion or second-signing attempt while the current mastery/rebase/packet evidence requirements are unresolved
hook_bindings.learning_evidence_location: protocols/NOVEL_MASTERY_MODEL.md defines evidence classes; audits/NOVEL_MASTERY_EVOLUTION_2026-10-11.md and project mastery/rebase audits record applied learning; raw research is not execution authority
hook_bindings.eval_or_regression_promotion_path: SKILL.md + protocols/ACTIVE_RULEBOOK.md + protocols/NOVEL_MASTERY_MODEL.md + project benchmarks + recovery/release-evidence guards + owner CI; research can produce L1 evidence, project L3 requires applied benchmark, and L4 requires repeated cross-project external outcomes
hook_bindings.superseded_mechanism_cleanup_rule: The old targeted front-arc matrix, old CH9 READY contract and old ARC_001 executable numbering are explicitly superseded/held; retired Library/Notion/legacy Drive executable material remains non-authoritative

overrides.evaluator_selection: Novel evolution is judged through competency-appropriate project benchmarks plus packet/chapter-specific role-separated review, identity regression, platform signing/reader evidence, periodic long-form/Canon checks and real reader/platform evidence when available; normal same-session review does not claim ATTESTED_ISOLATED assurance

methodology_assurance.boundary: Repository regression proves that the mastery model, series master outline, supersession rules, architecture freeze and recovery wiring are present and internally consistent. It does not prove deferred prose competencies, cross-project L4 mastery, better reader retention, or Fanqie signing success. Those higher claims require actual replacement prose, role-separated reviews and ultimately reader/platform/live-signing outcome evidence.
